jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션 (CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny 와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 14개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. 전 세계 유저들의 요구 사항을 분석하여 새로운 기능을 만들고 최첨단 의상 시뮬레이션 기술을 연구해 나갈 패기 넘치는 CLOver*를 모집해요! *CLOver는 전세계 CLO Virtual Fashion 구성원을 뜻하는 호칭이에요 :) 특히 컴퓨터 그래픽스/비전 관련 학위와 일정 수준의 C/C++ 기술을 보유한 여러분의 지원을 기다립니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰] → [최종 합격] ▶︎ 지원하실 때 이것을 제출해 주세요. • 경력사항이 잘 기술된 이력서(경력기술서) 1부 • 포트폴리오, 본인이 참여한 프로젝트 내용이 정리된 레퍼런스 (포트폴리오, 논문 혹은 Git과 같은 repo) *본 인턴십은 최소 2개월 근무를 기준으로 하며, 업무 상황 및 상호 협의에 따라 연장될 수 있습니다.

Nous embauchons pour la passion et la diversité, afin de triompher grâce à nos compétences collectives. Nos équipes sont composées d'une fusion de personnalités et d'intérêts unis par une nature collaborative, une culture axée sur le plaisir, et une volonté de tout mettre en œuvre pour créer d'excellents jeux. Et c'est là que vous intervenez... Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Programmeur de Jeux Sénior / d'une Programmeuse de Jeux Sénior contractuel(le) hautement expérimenté(e) et qualifié(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe. Dans ce rôle clé, vous développerez et maintiendrez des systèmes et des outils avancés, avec un accent particulier sur l'automatisation de nos workflows de développement et l'intégration d'agents IA dans nos pipelines. Vous concevrez des workflows agentiques qui accompagnent une tâche du ticket jusqu'à la merge request et à la revue de code. Vous dirigerez des projets d'envergure, aborderez des problèmes complexes et encadrerez les ingénieurs juniors dans l'adoption de ces pratiques. Nous sommes particulièrement enthousiastes à l'idée de ce que l'IA peut apporter au développement de jeux, et nous investissons dans les agents IA et l'automatisation pour que nos développeurs consacrent moins de temps aux tâches répétitives et plus de temps aux défis créatifs qui rendent les jeux amusants. jobs.title: Senior Game Programmer (Contract)
jobs.description_text: At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in... We're looking for a highly experienced and skilled contractSenior Programmer to join our team. In this pivotal role, you'll build and maintain advanced systems and tools, with a focus on automating our development workflows and bringing AI agents into our pipelines. You'll design agentic workflows that carry a task from ticket to merge request to code review, lead large-scale projects, tackle complex issues, and mentor junior engineers as the team adopts these practices. We’re especially excited about what AI can do for game development, and we’re investing in AI agents and automation so our developers spend less time on repetitive work and more time on the creative problems that make games fun. The Contractor shall provide the following services on an independent, deliverables basis, exercising their own professional judgment, expertise, and methods in performing the Services. We are open to working with the right candidate on a remote basis.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Hydrogen (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA Research builds and flies next-generation airships. Our proof-of-concept aircraft, Pathfinder 1, is the largest aircraft flying today, and we operate it as a working test platform to push airship technology forward: moving cargo and people to places without roads, runways, or ports, including disaster relief when infrastructure is cut off. Weight matters in every decision we make. This senior role owns mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems from concept through flight test, with a central part in developing the hydrogen propulsion system for our next aircraft. The base salary range for this role is $135,000 - 160,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you.

jobs.description_text: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions mission helps make the subscription experience seamless and reliable for millions of listeners around the world. We're building the technology that supports subscribers throughout their journey, from their first purchase to renewals, plan changes, and beyond. We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join Rover, the team responsible for Spotify's core subscription system. Our services manage the lifecycle of every Spotify subscription, including activation, renewals, plan changes, grace periods, and cancellations. You'll help build and improve the backend services and data systems that millions of subscribers depend on. Whether you're growing your engineering experience or looking for a new technical challenge, you'll have opportunities to learn, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact on Spotify's subscription experience.

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer. As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: The Subscriptions Mission builds and scales the products, platforms, and business models that turn free listeners into lifelong Premium subscribers. We focus on attracting new subscribers, improving conversion and retention, and creating seamless commerce experiences that support Spotify's growth and bring fans closer to the creators they love. At Spotify, subscription data helps shape the decisions and experiences behind our 700M+ monthly active users and 290M+ Premium subscribers. You'll join a collaborative team building the backend systems that power merchandising, personalized experiences, and subscription journeys at a global scale. Your work will help listeners discover the value of Premium and give them more reasons to stay.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Free and Premium Conversion
jobs.description_text: Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth. The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth. This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the future of Spotify's Freemium experience. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. Working closely with engineering, design, data science, research, marketing, and regional teams, you'll turn consumer insights into meaningful product experiences that drive sustainable subscriber growth.

jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Here at Lyft, data is at the core of every decision we make. It powers our business — helping us create great transportation experiences for our customers and providing insights into the effectiveness of our product launches and features.

As a Data Engineer on Lyft’s Marketplace – Decision Apps team, you will own and evolve the data pipelines that power our top-line financial, pricing, and driver-related metrics. You will collaborate with Analytics, Data Science, and Engineering partners to design data models and architectures — proposing innovative ideas, evaluating multiple approaches, and implementing solutions grounded in fundamental engineering principles and rigorous data analysis. Your work will provide seamless access to the insights that drive Lyft’s success.

Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of core data pipelines, ensuring resilience, optimal performance, timely delivery, data quality, and seamless onboarding of new features
  • Continuously evolve data models and schemas to meet business and engineering requirements
  • Implement and maintain systems to monitor and enhance data quality and consistency
  • Develop tools that support self-service management of data pipelines (ETL) and perform SQL tuning to optimize data processing

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Ad Infra (Lyft Ads)
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads is building the largest mobility media network. Brands use Lyft Ads to reach riders throughout their journeys, in the Lyft app, in the real world, and across the open web. Every time a rider opens the app, our systems decide in milliseconds which message they see, whether it’s a paid ad, an incentive, or a product message from another Lyft team.

The Ad Decisioning team owns that choice. We run the serving, pacing, and auction systems behind every ad on Lyft surfaces, and we are building a first-party decisioning platform that lets paid and unpaid messages compete in a single auction based on their value to riders, advertisers, and Lyft. This platform is shared infrastructure. Ads and other teams will all use it to reach riders and drivers across multiple apps and surfaces. The work spans real-time distributed systems, auction design, and close partnership with teams across Lyft that message riders and drivers.

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead this team. You will spend a meaningful share of your time on technical work: shaping architecture, reviewing designs and code, and building with AI tools alongside your engineers. The Marketplace organization at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Pricing sits at the heart of it. The Dynamic Pricing & Offer Selection team uses real-time and historical data to set the price of every ride on Lyft, balancing price and ETA so riders have a great experience and drivers have earning opportunities when and where demand is highest. You'll own the reliability and evolution of dynamic pricing systems that operate at Lyft's full scale, partner closely with our technical and product leadership to define the roadmap, and grow a strong team of engineers. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description_text:
Senior Data Scientist, Decisions – Autonomous Vehicles

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The future of Lyft is a hybrid network, where autonomous vehicles and human drivers serve riders side by side on one platform. That future has already started. In September 2026, Lyft riders in Nashville were matched with Waymo autonomous vehicles on the Lyft app for the first time. Our partnerships now span Waymo in Nashville, May Mobility in Atlanta and Baidu in Europe, with more on the way.

The Global Growth organization is charting the future of Lyft’s growth beyond North American rideshare’s core products, including bringing Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) to riders domestically and abroad. As a Senior Data Scientist, Decisions for AV, you will be the science partner for the AV product team. You’ll use experimentation and data to decide what we build, how we launch it, and how we know it’s working. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, operations and partnership leaders, and present your recommendations to senior leadership and AV partners.

In this role, you will help us answer questions such as:

  • Rider adoption and trust: What makes a rider choose, accept or opt out of an autonomous ride, and which product changes increase adoption?

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Mapping
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

For us, maps aren't just background graphics—they’re the core of the driver’s experience. While generic navigation apps focus on the everyday commute, Lyft Mapping is custom-built for the high-stakes, split-second realities of the rideshare experience. Drivers choose Lyft Maps because we solve the unique, complex challenges of living on the road: delivering glanceable turn guidance at speed, navigating tricky pick-up & drop-off dynamics, and providing real-time, AI-powered route assistance when every second counts. We build technology that empowers our drivers, transforms uncertainty into seamless flow, and sets the standard for real-time mobile navigation.

We obsess over questions like: did your pickup spot feel safe and convenient? Did your driver feel confident following the route and arriving on the correct side of the road? Did you get stuck in unexpected traffic or road closures? You will tackle all of these challenges and more, with end to end ownership over the full ride experience, including driver navigation and rider pickup experiences.

You own the vulnerability management lifecycle across our infrastructure, cloud, container and application estate: from discovery and prioritization to validated findings, ready-to-apply fixes and verified closure. We are not looking for someone who forwards scanner reports. We are looking for an engineer who can independently confirm that a vulnerability is real and exploitable in our environment, understand its root cause, and come to the development or infrastructure team with a concrete, tested solution: a patch plan, a configuration change, a pull request, a hardened image, or a compensating control. You earn trust with engineering teams by being technically right and by making the fix easy. You work closely with the security program manager, platform and infrastructure teams, and application developers, and you help shape how vulnerability management is run at Xsolla as the program matures. Depending on your level, you will either drive the program day to day (Middle) or define its strategy, standards and tooling and mentor others (Senior). Our tech stack includes GCP, vSphere/ESX, Kubernetes and container workloads, MariaDB, CockroachDB, Go, PHP, and Python.
